text_block_list.text:
Victorious am I! Just as all expected,
today's
Derby was one for the ages!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
And yet my worthy adversary, whose
intensity
surpasses the Golden
Generation's, declines me!
It seems that
to run by my side is an honor too
high.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Nevertheless, the winds of time billow
my sails!
Even without a worthy foe, the
crowds roar for
me. They yearn for the
bell to toll and mark the
passing of an
era!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
So ring it I shall. The Golden Generation
awaits at
the Arima Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
